user.title: Connect Washington Gas
user.description: Sign in with your login for wgl.opower.com, Washington Gas's Home Energy Analysis site. Your My Washington Gas login (my.washingtongas.com) won't work here: that site's sign-in uses a CAPTCHA, which the integration won't try to get around. If you don't have a wgl.opower.com login yet, [create one]({create_account_url}) with the account number from your bill, then enter it below.

data_description.energy_unit: Home Assistant has no therm unit. "Therms" keeps the same numbers as your bill (labeled CCF in the Energy dashboard). "kWh" converts them exactly (1 therm = 29.3071 kWh). This can't be changed later without removing and re-adding the integration.

reauth_confirm.title: Washington Gas password
reauth_confirm.description: The saved password for {username} stopped working. Enter the one you use at wgl.opower.com now.

error.invalid_auth: wgl.opower.com didn't accept that email and password. Check that they work there. Your My Washington Gas login is separate and won't work here.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't sign in to wgl.opower.com. Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, run scripts/check_connection.py from the integration's GitHub page to see which step fails.
error.no_accounts: That login worked, but no gas accounts are linked to it yet.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Washington Gas login is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new password works. Washington Gas is reconnected.
